verdict.rationale: Alacritty's README explicitly leaves tabs and splits to 'a window manager or terminal multiplexer', and several users report running tmux inside it day to day. One user notes all tmux shortcuts worked without any configuration, and another praises fast rendering of tmux panes. A WSL2 user could not get some modifier shortcuts working with tmux, but this is a key-mapping edge case that other users contradict, not a failure to run tmux. Missing for 10: first-party documentation specifically covering tmux usage, any native tmux integration or control mode, and clear resolution of the reported modifier-key issues with tmux on WSL2.
